projectState.summary: Byte editor-ux-cleanup is implemented on codex/byte-editor-ux-cleanup, stacked on the L4b branch because origin/main does not yet include L4b. The melody editor now opens from a visible Melody action through a compact player menu, the overlay is narrow and internally scroll-contained, and edit/catalog controls use progressive disclosure: catalog list inside the editor, Anchor/Connector panels collapsed until selection, Connector More for secondary knobs. This is presentation-only: no edit model, persistence/catalog semantics, renderer, scorer, transport, scheduling, server, or window.phraseEditor behavior changed. Validation: build green, six unit suites green, editor-focused smoke green, full smoke 76/76 twice on a reused non-clean DB, db:smoke green, diff-check green; npm audit still reports known Vite/esbuild advisories.
